ChromeScaffold

Скаффолд, у которого верх и низ — зоны блюра, подогнанные под высоту баров и липких заголовков.

Как выглядит

Что это

Основа всех экранов: слои снизу вверх — body (скроллится под зонами) → прогрессивный блюр сверху/снизу → topBar/bottomBar. Высоты баров регистрируются автоматически (ChromeBar или самообслуживаемые LargeTitleHeader, CollapsibleBar).

Когда использовать

Когда нужен нативный «scroll edge effect» iOS 26. Если хватает готового — берите SwiftUiScaffold, он сделан поверх этого.

Пример

ChromeScaffold(
  topBar: const LargeTitleHeader(title: 'Library'),
  body: ListView.builder(
    itemCount: 50,
    itemBuilder: (_, i) => ListRow(title: 'Item $i'),
  ),
  bottomBar: ChromeBar(
    edge: ChromeEdge.bottom,
    child: GlassTabBar(selectedIndex: 0, onSelected: (_) {}, tabs: [GlassTab(icon: RavelIcon(RavelIconKind.chat), label: 'Chats')]),
  ),
)

Если тело — CustomScrollView, первым слайвером поставьте SliverChromeInset.top(). Для горизонтального пейджера списков: scrollDepth: 1.

Эффект под барами задаётся topChrome/bottomChrome (ChromeStyle.soft/fade/solid/none…) или для поддерева через ChromeStyleScope.

Параметры (из dartdoc)

ChromeScaffold
ПараметрТипПо умолчаниюОписание
bodyWidgetrequired
topBarWidget?Placed under the status bar. Wrap in ChromeBar (or a widget that registers itself, like LargeTitleHeader) so the scaffold learns its height.
bottomBarWidget?
controllerChromeController?
backgroundColorColor?
overlayWidget?Extra widget above everything (e.g. a drawer shade).
topChromeChromeStyle?How content leaves under the top / bottom bars (see ChromeStyle). Null: the one of the surrounding ChromeStyleScope, else ChromeStyle.soft.
bottomChromeChromeStyle?
bottomBlurbooltruefalse: no blur zone at the bottom edge (the content scrolls under the bottom bar / home indicator unblurred).
bottomBarSafeAreaSharedouble?0..1: the share of the bottom safe area (the home indicator, 34 pt on a modern iPhone) kept below bottomBar. 1 lifts the bar by the whole inset, 0 presses it to the very edge.
minTopInsetdouble12The least space (pt) above the top bar. A screen under the status bar already has more (the system inset wins); a sheet or a dialog without a safe area has none, and the bar would sit against its edge: this keeps a little air there.
freezeUnderRouteboolfalsetrue: while another route moves over this page it is drawn as a snapshot (see FreezeUnderRoute): cheaper for the GPU during the transition, but the page does not update under it. Default false: the page stays live.
snapLargeTitlebooltrueNative large-title behaviour: when a scroll ends while the large title (or a CollapsibleBar section) is half collapsed, the content settles to fully open or fully collapsed, whichever is nearer.
blockZoneTouchesboolfalsetrue: the blur zones swallow touches, so content that is under a zone (blurred, half hidden behind a bar) cannot be pressed through it. The bars and stuck headers above the zones stay interactive.
scrollDepthint0How many scrollables sit between the body and the vertical list that drives the bars: 0 for a plain list, 1 when the body is a horizontal pager of lists (PageView).
ChromeBar
ПараметрТипПо умолчаниюОписание
childWidgetrequired
edgeChromeEdgeChromeEdge.top
animatebooltrueAnimate height changes (including the first registration).
labelString?
glassSpacingdouble14Glass morph distance of the plates in the bar (see LiquidGlassGroup.spacing): neighbours closer than this melt into one shape while one of them is pressed, like a native glass container. 0 keeps every plate separate.
